A. Ampere
B. Joule
C. Newton

2.text_clean:
2. The graph shows the acceleration $a$ of an object as time $t$ varies.
[Graph: $a$ / m s$^{-2}$ (0 to 20) against $t$ / s (0 to 7); $a$ rises linearly from 0 at $t=0$ to 10 at $t=2$, stays at 10 until $t=4$, then falls linearly to 0 at $t=6$]
What is the magnitude of the change in the velocity of the object between 0 and 3 seconds?
A. 5 m s$^{-1}$
B. 10 m s$^{-1}$
C. 20 m s$^{-1}$
D. 30 m s$^{-1}$

3.text_clean:
3. A force $F$ acts on a block at an angle $\theta$ with respect to a horizontal surface.
[Diagram: block on a horizontal surface moving to the right with velocity $v$; force $F$ pulls at angle $\theta$ above the horizontal]
The block is moving with a constant velocity $v$ along the surface. A resistive force acts on the block.
Which of the following correctly represents the forces acting on the block?
[Four free-body diagrams with arrows labelled reaction force, weight, friction and $F$:
A. reaction force up, weight down, $F$ at angle $\theta$ above horizontal, friction pointing right (forward)
B. reaction force up, weight down, friction left, $F$ horizontal to the right
C. reaction force up, weight down, friction left, $F$ at angle $\theta$
D. reaction force up, weight down, friction left, $F$ at angle $\theta$ above horizontal]

4. A student makes three statements about situations in which no work is done on an object.
I. The object is moving with uniform circular motion.
II. A force is applied to the object in the direction of its velocity.
III. A force is applied to the object in a direction opposite to its motion.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
A. I only
B. I and II only
C. I and III only
D. III only

[Four diagrams of a circle traversed anticlockwise with P at the bottom:
A. $v$ and $a$ both tangential to the right
B. $a$ towards the centre (up), $v$ tangential to the right
C. $v$ up (towards centre), $a$ to the right
D. $v$ up (towards centre), $a$ down (away from centre)]

A. $u\cos 55°$
B. $u\sin 55°$
C. $u$
D. $u\tan 55°$

Which of the following gives the correct value of $\frac{P_x}{P_y}$?
A. $\frac{1}{15}$
B. $\frac{3}{5}$
C. $\frac{5}{3}$

18. A coherent beam of light of wavelength $\lambda$ is incident on a double slit. The width of the slits is small compared to their separation. An interference pattern is observed on a distant screen. O is the mid point of the screen.
[Diagram: coherent beam incident on a double slit; screen with central point O and point P above it (not to scale)]

Which of the following is the path difference between the light from the two slits arriving at P?
A. $1.5\lambda$
B. $2\lambda$
C. $3\lambda$
D. $4\lambda$

32.text_clean:
32. Which of the following is a correct list of particles upon which the strong nuclear force may act?
A. protons and neutrons
B. protons and electrons
C. neutrons and electrons
D. protons, neutrons and electrons
32.note: Official key D (protons, neutrons and electrons). Electrons are leptons and do not experience the strong nuclear force; the physically correct answer is A (protons and neutrons). Key letter verified in markscheme PDF, so likely an error in the official key.
